The real-RPC test captures `onHeaders` observations and verifies the exact caller span and custom context value on the test thread, along with callback delivery and RPC success. threads.body: These assertions check the caller context inside asynchronous `onHeaders`, but would still pass if that context leaked onto the delivery thread; they also do not exercise inline delivery during `start`. The Coverage section of `.github/instructions/context-propagation.instructions.md` requires inline execution and restoration of an unrelated callback-thread context. Add controlled delivery tests that verify the caller context inside the callback, restoration of the delivery context after normal and exceptional returns, and restoration of the outgoing context when inline `start` execution resumes.

Verified on fe43e9d1. The inline case checks that the outgoing context is restored before the delegate resumes. The deferred cases check that a distinct delivery context is restored both when the callback returns normally and when it throws.
